examples.en: They live in a small apartment.
examples.zh: 他们住在一间小公寓里。

examples.en: The apartment has two bedrooms.

mnemonic.tip: apart(分开)+ment，一栋楼被"分开"成一户户就是公寓。

examples.en: She rents a flat in the city.
examples.zh: 她在城里租了一套公寓。

examples.en: Our flat is on the top floor.

mnemonic.tip: flat 本义"平的"，楼里平层的一户就是公寓(英式常用 flat)。

examples.en: Birds sat on the roof.
The roof leaks when it rains.

mnemonic.tip: roof 谐音"路夫"——两个 o 像屋顶两片瓦，盖在房子最上面。

examples.en: There is a light on the ceiling.
The ceiling is very high.

mnemonic.tip: ceiling 谐音"西林"——抬头看到房间里"顶"上那一片就是天花板。

examples.en: She ran up the stairs.
Be careful on the stairs.

mnemonic.tip: stairs 谐音"斯泰尔斯"——一级一级往上"抬"脚走的就是楼梯(总用复数)。

examples.en: Take the lift to the fifth floor.
The lift is out of order.

mnemonic.tip: lift 本义"举起"，把人"举"上楼的箱子就是电梯(英式用 lift)。

examples.en: The car is in the garage.
He fixed his bike in the garage.

mnemonic.tip: garage 谐音"嘎拉日"——停车、放杂物的房间就是车库。

examples.en: We grow flowers in the garden.
The children played in the garden.

mnemonic.tip: garden 谐音"嘎登"——园子里"咯噔"一铲种下花草就是花园。

examples.en: A wooden fence goes around the yard.
The cat jumped over the fence.

mnemonic.tip: fence 谐音"翻死"——围起来"防"人翻进来的就是栅栏。

examples.en: They bought new furniture.
The room has little furniture.

mnemonic.tip: furniture 谐音"佛尼车"——桌椅床柜等摆设的总称就是家具(不可数)。

examples.en: We sat on the sofa to watch TV.
examples.zh: 我们坐在沙发上看电视。

examples.en: The cat sleeps on the sofa.

mnemonic.tip: sofa 谐音"沙发"——直接就是它的中文译音。

examples.en: Put a cushion behind your back.
The sofa has soft cushions.

mnemonic.tip: cushion 谐音"酷神"——软软一垫，坐得舒服就是靠垫。

examples.en: Close the curtains at night.
The curtains are pale blue.

mnemonic.tip: curtain 谐音"科腾"——一拉挡住光和视线的布就是窗帘。

examples.en: A soft carpet covers the floor.
examples.zh: 一块软地毯铺满了地板。

examples.en: Don't spill juice on the carpet.

mnemonic.tip: carpet 谐音"卡皮特"——铺在地上、踩着软乎乎的就是地毯。

examples.en: Hang your coat in the wardrobe.
Her wardrobe is full of dresses.

mnemonic.tip: ward(看守，同 guard)+robe(长袍)，看守存放衣袍的柜子就是衣柜。

examples.en: The keys are in the top drawer.
examples.zh: 钥匙在最上面的抽屉里。

examples.en: She opened the drawer slowly.

mnemonic.tip: draw(拉)+er(物)，一拉就出来的格子就是抽屉。

examples.en: The books are on the shelf.
Put the cups on the top shelf.

mnemonic.tip: shelf 谐音"谢尔夫"——复数变 shelves，墙上放东西的板就是架子。

examples.en: The plates are in the cupboard.
She keeps snacks in the cupboard.

mnemonic.tip: cup(杯)+board(板)，放杯盘碗碟的板柜就是橱柜(p不发音，读/ˈkʌbəd/)。

examples.en: Wash the dishes in the sink.
The sink is full of water.

mnemonic.tip: sink 也作动词"下沉"，水往下"沉"流走的池子就是水槽。

examples.en: Turn off the tap to save water.
Water dripped from the tap.

mnemonic.tip: tap 也有"轻拍"义，轻轻一拧一"拍"就出水的就是水龙头。

examples.en: She cooked soup on the cooker.
The gas cooker has four rings.
examples.zh: 这个煤气灶有四个灶眼。

mnemonic.tip: cook(做饭)+er(器具)，做饭用的炉子就是 cooker(注意不是"厨师")。

examples.en: Put the cake in the oven.
The oven is very hot.

mnemonic.tip: oven 谐音"阿闻"——蛋糕在里面烤得香喷喷，"阿，闻到了"就是烤箱。

examples.en: Keep the milk in the fridge.
The fridge is full of food.

mnemonic.tip: fridge 是 refrigerator 的简写，里面 frid 像 frigid(寒冷)，冷藏食物的就是冰箱。

examples.en: Heat the soup in the microwave.
The microwave beeps when it's done.

mnemonic.tip: micro(微)+wave(波)，用微小的电波加热食物的炉子就是微波炉。

examples.en: Put the kettle on for tea.
The kettle is boiling.

mnemonic.tip: kettle 谐音"开头"——烧开水时"咕嘟"响的壶就是水壶。

examples.en: I like a soft pillow.
She put her head on the pillow.

mnemonic.tip: pillow 谐音"皮漏"——软软垫在头下睡觉的就是枕头。

examples.en: Cover the baby with a blanket.
It's cold, so use two blankets.

mnemonic.tip: blanket 谐音"布软克"——一块厚布盖着暖身就是毯子。

examples.en: She looked at herself in the mirror.
There is a mirror on the wall.

mnemonic.tip: mirror 谐音"米若"——照出你模样的就是镜子。

examples.en: Turn on the lamp to read.
There is a lamp beside the bed.

mnemonic.tip: lamp 谐音"蓝普"——一按就亮的灯就是 lamp。

examples.en: They rent a house near the sea.
examples.zh: 他们在海边租了一栋房子。

examples.en: The rent is quite high here.

mnemonic.tip: rent 谐音"润"——每月付钱"润"手让你住，就是租。

examples.en: The landlord fixed the heating.
We pay the landlord every month.

mnemonic.tip: land(地/房产)+lord(主人)，房产的主人就是房东。

examples.en: The tenant pays rent on time.
New tenants moved in next door.

mnemonic.tip: ten(持有，同 hold/maintain)+ant(人)，付钱"持有"使用权住着的人就是房客。

examples.en: They moved to a bigger house.
examples.zh: 他们搬进了一栋更大的房子。

examples.en: Help me move the sofa.

mnemonic.tip: move 谐音"姆夫"——把家当搬到新地方就是 move(house)。

examples.en: We decorated the room for the party.
examples.zh: 我们为聚会装饰了房间。

examples.en: They decorated the walls with pictures.

mnemonic.tip: decor(装饰，同 décor)+ate，把房间打扮漂亮就是装饰。

examples.en: Keep your room tidy.
Please tidy up your desk.

mnemonic.tip: tidy 谐音"泰迪"——像泰迪熊摆得整整齐齐就是整洁。

examples.en: His bedroom is always messy.
examples.zh: 他的卧室总是乱糟糟的。

examples.en: The kitchen looked messy after cooking.
examples.zh: 做完饭厨房看起来很乱。

mnemonic.tip: mess(一团糟)+y，乱成一团就是 messy。

examples.en: This chair is very comfortable.
Make yourself comfortable.

mnemonic.tip: comfort(安慰/舒适)+able(能)，能让人舒适的就是 comfortable。

examples.en: The small room felt warm and cosy.
examples.zh: 这个小房间又暖又温馨。

examples.en: We sat by the cosy fire.
examples.zh: 我们坐在温暖舒适的炉火边。

mnemonic.tip: cosy 谐音"扣子"——小而暖、窝着像扣进被窝一样舒服就是 cosy。

examples.en: Open the window and let some air in.
She watched the rain through the window.

mnemonic.tip: wind(风)+ow→风进来的口子→窗户。

examples.en: Someone is knocking at the door.
Please close the door quietly.
We painted the walls light blue.
examples.zh: 我们把墙刷成了浅蓝色。

examples.en: There is a world map on my bedroom wall.
examples.zh: 我卧室墙上有张世界地图。

mnemonic.tip: wall 墙——the Great Wall 长城，世界上最长的 wall。

examples.en: Don't leave your clothes on the floor.
Our flat is on the fifth floor.

mnemonic.tip: 英式楼层：ground floor 一楼，first floor 二楼——PET 考英式。

examples.en: I share a bedroom with my little brother.
examples.zh: 我和弟弟共用一间卧室。

examples.en: Her bedroom is always tidy.
examples.zh: 她的卧室总是整整齐齐。

mnemonic.tip: bed(床)+room(房间)→放床的房间→卧室。

examples.en: The bathroom is at the end of the hall.
He spends ages in the bathroom every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上在卫生间里磨蹭很久。

mnemonic.tip: bath(洗澡)+room(房间)→洗澡的房间→浴室。

examples.en: Something smells great in the kitchen.
We eat breakfast in the kitchen.
The family watches TV in the living room.
The living room has a big soft sofa.
examples.zh: 客厅里有个又大又软的沙发。

mnemonic.tip: living(生活)+room→一家人待得最多的房间→客厅。

examples.en: We only use the dining room for special dinners.
examples.zh: 我们只在特别的晚餐用餐厅。

examples.en: The dining room table seats eight people.
examples.zh: 餐厅的桌子能坐八个人。

mnemonic.tip: dine(用餐)+ing+room→吃饭的房间→餐厅。

examples.en: Old toys are stored in the attic.
We found Grandma's letters in the attic.
examples.zh: 我们在阁楼里发现了奶奶的信。

mnemonic.tip: attic 谐音"阿踢可"——上阁楼的梯子窄，小心别踢到。

examples.en: The washing machine is down in the basement.
They turned the basement into a games room.
examples.zh: 他们把地下室改成了游戏室。

mnemonic.tip: base(底部)+ment→房子最底下的空间→地下室。

examples.en: Smoke rose from the cottage chimney.
Father Christmas comes down the chimney.

mnemonic.tip: chimney 谐音"欠妮"——烟囱冒烟像在跟人打招呼。

examples.en: Dad cuts the lawn every other weekend.
examples.zh: 爸爸隔周修剪一次草坪。

examples.en: The children played on the lawn.

mnemonic.tip: lawn 谐音"捞恩"——草坪软软的，躺上去真享受。

examples.en: The dog sleeps in the yard.
Kids were playing basketball in the school yard.
examples.zh: 孩子们在校园场地上打篮球。

mnemonic.tip: yard 谐音"晾的"——院子里晾着衣服。

examples.en: The bikes are kept in the garden shed.
examples.zh: 自行车放在花园棚屋里。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps his tools in the shed.
examples.zh: 爷爷把工具放在棚子里。

mnemonic.tip: shed 谐音"舍的"——舍不得扔的东西都堆在棚里。

examples.en: The doorbell rang during dinner.
Press the doorbell twice for our flat.

mnemonic.tip: door(门)+bell(铃)→门铃。

examples.en: Did you lock the front door?
The lock on my drawer is broken.

mnemonic.tip: lock 锁——locker 带锁的柜子就是它加 er。

examples.en: I can't find my keys anywhere!
Practice is the key to learning English.
examples.zh: 练习是学好英语的关键。

mnemonic.tip: key 钥匙；引申"关键"——the key to 的钥匙/关键。

examples.en: He climbed the ladder to clean the windows.
Hold the ladder steady for me, please.

mnemonic.tip: ladder 谐音"拉的"——爬梯子手要拉得紧。

examples.en: The house is built of red brick.
A pile of bricks lay by the wall.

mnemonic.tip: brick 谐音"不离刻"——砖块垒墙，一块紧挨一块不离开。

examples.en: The bridge is made of steel and concrete.
examples.zh: 这座桥由钢和混凝土建成。

examples.en: Give me a concrete example, please.
examples.zh: 请给我一个具体的例子。

mnemonic.tip: concrete 谐音"抗磕的"——混凝土硬，抗磕抗压。

examples.en: Grandpa fell asleep in his armchair.
examples.zh: 爷爷在扶手椅里睡着了。

examples.en: The cat loves the old armchair by the window.
examples.zh: 猫最爱窗边那把旧扶手椅。

mnemonic.tip: arm(手臂)+chair(椅子)→有扶手放手臂的椅子。

examples.en: The bookcase is full—I need a new one.
examples.zh: 书柜满了——我需要个新的。

examples.en: She arranged her books in the bookcase by colour.
examples.zh: 她按颜色把书排进书柜。

mnemonic.tip: book(书)+case(柜子)→放书的柜子→书柜。

examples.en: My desk is by the bedroom window.
examples.zh: 我的书桌靠着卧室窗户。

examples.en: Keep your desk tidy when you study.
We sat on a bench in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们坐在花园的长凳上。

examples.en: The old man feeds birds from the park bench.
examples.zh: 老人坐在公园长凳上喂鸟。

mnemonic.tip: bench 谐音"板凳吃"——坐在板凳上吃东西。

examples.en: She stood on a stool to reach the top shelf.
examples.zh: 她站在凳子上够顶层架子。

examples.en: There are tall stools at the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 厨房台边有几张高脚凳。

mnemonic.tip: stool 谐音"死蹲"——没靠背的凳子只能干坐着。

examples.en: I have a hot bath before bed.
The baby splashed water all over the bath.
examples.zh: 宝宝把水溅得浴缸到处都是。

mnemonic.tip: have a bath 泡澡，have a shower 淋浴——英式说法。

examples.en: The little ducks floated in the bathtub.
examples.zh: 小鸭子玩具漂在浴缸里。

examples.en: She filled the bathtub with warm water.

mnemonic.tip: bath(洗澡)+tub(盆)→洗澡的大盆→浴缸。

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?
Remember to flush the toilet.

mnemonic.tip: 英式问厕所说 toilet/loo，美式说 bathroom/restroom。

examples.en: Dry your hands with this towel.
Take a beach towel for the swimming pool.

mnemonic.tip: towel 谐音"掏我"——洗完澡掏出毛巾擦干。

examples.en: Wash your hands with soap and water.
This soap smells of lemon.

mnemonic.tip: soap 谐音"搓泡"——肥皂一搓全是泡。

examples.en: The cat curled up on the rug by the fire.
examples.zh: 猫蜷在炉火旁的小地毯上。

examples.en: A colourful rug covers the wooden floor.
examples.zh: 一块彩色小毯铺在木地板上。

mnemonic.tip: rug 小块可移动，carpet 大块铺满——都在地上。

examples.en: Mum changes the sheets every week.
Take a clean sheet of paper.

mnemonic.tip: 床单和纸都是"薄薄一大张"——a sheet of paper 一张纸。

examples.en: It's cold—get under the duvet.
She hid under the duvet during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨时她躲在被子下。

mnemonic.tip: 法语词，t 不发音 /ˈduːveɪ/——英国人管厚被子叫 duvet。

examples.en: A good mattress helps you sleep well.
The mattress is too soft for my back.
examples.zh: 这床垫对我的背来说太软了。

mnemonic.tip: mattress 谐音"马特软死"——床垫软软的。

examples.en: The twins sleep in a bunk bed.
I always choose the top bunk bed at camp.

mnemonic.tip: bunk(铺位)+bed(床)→上下铺的床→双层床。

examples.en: Put your dirty clothes in the washing machine.
The washing machine is making a strange noise.
examples.zh: 洗衣机发出奇怪的响声。

mnemonic.tip: washing(洗)+machine(机器)→洗衣机。

examples.en: Load the dishwasher after dinner, please.
examples.zh: 晚饭后请把碗放进洗碗机。

examples.en: The dishwasher saves us a lot of time.
examples.zh: 洗碗机帮我们省了很多时间。

mnemonic.tip: dish(碗碟)+washer(清洗器)→洗碗机。

examples.en: The vacuum cleaner scared the cat away.
He pushed the vacuum cleaner around the living room.
examples.zh: 他推着吸尘器打扫客厅。

mnemonic.tip: vacuum(真空)+cleaner(清洁器)→靠吸力除尘的机器。

examples.en: Dad irons his shirts on Sunday evenings.
The gate is made of iron.

mnemonic.tip: 注意发音 /ˈaɪən/——r 不发音；铁、熨斗、熨衣服都是它。

examples.en: Sweep the leaves away with a broom.
The witch in the story flies on a broom.
examples.zh: 故事里的女巫骑扫帚飞。

mnemonic.tip: broom 谐音"不入木"——扫帚扫地不扫床。

examples.en: Fill the bucket with warm water.
The children built sandcastles with buckets.

mnemonic.tip: bucket 谐音"拔剋的"——提水桶要用力拔。

examples.en: Mop the kitchen floor—it's sticky.
examples.zh: 拖一下厨房地板——黏黏的。

examples.en: He mopped up the spilt milk.
examples.zh: 他把洒的牛奶拖干净了。

mnemonic.tip: mop 谐音"抹布"——拖把就是长杆抹布。

examples.en: Take the rubbish out to the dustbin.
examples.zh: 把垃圾拿出去扔进垃圾桶。

examples.en: The dustbin is emptied every Tuesday.

mnemonic.tip: dust(灰尘)+bin(桶)→装脏东西的桶→垃圾桶。

examples.en: Turn up the heating—it's freezing in here.
examples.zh: 把暖气开大点——屋里冷死了。

examples.en: The heating comes on at six in the morning.

mnemonic.tip: heat(热)+ing→供热系统→暖气。

examples.en: She turned on the small heater in her room.
examples.zh: 她打开了房间里的小取暖器。

examples.en: The water heater is broken again.

mnemonic.tip: heat(加热)+er(器具)→加热的器具。

examples.en: The classroom has no air conditioning.
Turn on the air conditioning—it's 35 degrees!

mnemonic.tip: air(空气)+conditioning(调节)→调节空气→空调。

examples.en: The light bulb in the hall needs changing.
Edison made the light bulb famous.
examples.zh: 爱迪生让电灯泡闻名于世。

mnemonic.tip: light(光)+bulb(球状物)→发光的小球→灯泡。

examples.en: The light switch is by the door.
Let's switch places so you can see better.
examples.zh: 我们换个位置，你能看得更清楚。

mnemonic.tip: switch 开关；switch on/off 开/关——名词动词一起记。

examples.en: The smoke alarm went off while Dad was cooking.
examples.zh: 爸爸做饭时烟雾报警器响了。

examples.en: Check the smoke alarm battery every year.
examples.zh: 每年检查烟雾报警器的电池。

mnemonic.tip: smoke(烟)+alarm(警报)→闻到烟就叫的警报器。

examples.en: There's a mountain of laundry to do.
He does the laundry every Saturday.

mnemonic.tip: laundry 谐音"烂得利"——衣服穿烂了才洗可不行。

examples.en: Wipe your shoes on the doormat.
The key is hidden under the doormat.

mnemonic.tip: door(门)+mat(垫子)→门口的垫子。

examples.en: Mum put the roses in a glass vase.
examples.zh: 妈妈把玫瑰插进玻璃花瓶。

examples.en: The cat knocked the vase off the table.
examples.zh: 猫把花瓶从桌上碰掉了。

mnemonic.tip: vase 谐音"哇死"——花瓶摔了，哇，死定了。

examples.en: She blew out the candles on her cake.
examples.zh: 她吹灭了蛋糕上的蜡烛。

examples.en: We lit candles when the power went off.

mnemonic.tip: candle 谐音"看豆"——烛光如豆，看着暖暖的。

examples.en: Sweep the floor before the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 客人来之前把地扫一扫。

examples.en: He swept the broken glass into a corner.

mnemonic.tip: sweep 谐音"死威扑"——扫帚呼呼地扑向灰尘。

examples.en: The shelves were covered in dust.
She dusted the piano carefully.
examples.zh: 她仔细掸去钢琴上的灰。

mnemonic.tip: dust 灰尘；动词"掸灰"——dustbin 垃圾桶也从它来。

examples.en: He polished his shoes until they shone.
Polish the mirror with a dry cloth.

mnemonic.tip: polish 谐音"抛光洗"——擦到发光。

examples.en: Hang your coat on the hook.
We hung family photos along the stairs.
examples.zh: 我们沿楼梯挂了全家福。

mnemonic.tip: hang-hung-hung 挂——hang out 闲逛是口语引申。

examples.en: Can you fix my broken headphones?
Dad fixed the shelf to the wall.
examples.zh: 爸爸把架子固定在墙上。

mnemonic.tip: fix 修理+固定——把坏的"固定"回原样→修好。

examples.en: The roof needs repairing before winter.
The repairs cost two hundred pounds.

mnemonic.tip: re(再)+pair(准备好)→让东西再次能用→修理。

examples.en: The new family moved in last month.
examples.zh: 新住户上个月搬进来了。

examples.en: We can move in as soon as the house is painted.
examples.zh: 房子刷完漆我们就能搬进去。

examples.en: My big sister moved out when she started work.
examples.zh: 姐姐开始工作后就搬出去住了。

examples.en: They're moving out at the end of the month.
Put away your toys before bed.
He put the dishes away in the cupboard.

mnemonic.tip: put(放)+away(走)→放回它该在的地方→收好。

examples.en: Tidy up your room—it's a mess!
examples.zh: 把你房间收拾一下——乱死了！

examples.en: We tidied up together after the party.

mnemonic.tip: tidy(整洁)+up(彻底)→彻底弄整洁→收拾。

examples.en: I make my bed as soon as I get up.
Making the bed takes only one minute.

mnemonic.tip: make the bed 不是"做床"——是把被子铺整齐。

examples.en: The bedrooms are upstairs.
I heard footsteps upstairs.

mnemonic.tip: up(上)+stairs(楼梯)→楼梯上面→楼上。

examples.en: Breakfast is ready—come downstairs!
The kitchen is downstairs on the left.

mnemonic.tip: down(下)+stairs(楼梯)→楼梯下面→楼下。

examples.en: Stay indoors during the storm.
We played indoors because of the rain.
examples.zh: 因为下雨我们在室内玩。

mnemonic.tip: in(内)+doors(门)→门里面→室内。

examples.en: Children should play outdoors more.
We had lunch outdoors in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们在花园里露天吃午饭。

mnemonic.tip: out(外)+doors(门)→门外面→户外。

examples.en: The new flat is bright and spacious.
They need a more spacious house for six people.
examples.zh: 六口人需要更宽敞的房子。

mnemonic.tip: space(空间)+ious→空间大的→宽敞的。

examples.en: The wooden floor creaks at night.
A wooden table stood in the middle of the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房中间摆着一张木桌。

mnemonic.tip: wood(木头)+en(材质后缀)→木头做的。

examples.en: They rented a furnished flat near the station.
examples.zh: 他们在车站附近租了带家具的公寓。

examples.en: The room comes furnished with a bed and desk.

mnemonic.tip: furniture(家具)同根——配好家具的。
